description: This file defines the BuzzFeedAPI class, which serves as an API endpoint for retrieving buzz feed posts, including fetching the list of posts with support for sorting and pagination. It is a part of the OrangeHRM system's Buzz module and uses traits and other components for handling services and authentication.

classes.name: BuzzFeedAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing and retrieving buzz feed posts within the OrangeHRM system, supporting listing with pagination and sorting, but not creation or deletion.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a list of buzz feed posts, applying filters, pagination, sorting, and including the auth user's employee number.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getAll' method, primarily for sorting and pagination parameters.
